Leveraging  their  known  transcriptomic  profiles  from L1000,  we  evaluated  these  molecules  by  assessing  NRF2  downstream  gene induction  and  ranking  based  on  their  magnitude  of  induction. As  expected,  highscoring molecules (>0.6) ranked above random L1000 compounds ( Fig. 4f; Methods ), demonstrating  GEMGen's ability  to  recover  and  prioritize  phenotype-recapitulating molecules.
